definitions.event_recall: Observed GT events only; partial GT clipped to evaluated support; unobserved GT excluded and listed.
definitions.event_matching: One-to-one matching maximizes count of IoU-eligible pairs, then total IoU.
definitions.coverage: Union of scored cells (y_hard in {0,1}, label_weight>0), never nominal seam length.
definitions.frame_weighting: Unweighted hard-label frame metrics; label_weight controls inclusion only.
definitions.boundary_mae: Matched fully covered GT only; mean absolute start/end error.
definitions.ece: 10 fixed equal-width probability bins; absolute mean probability minus positive frequency.
definitions.delay: First threshold-positive observation in a matched predicted interval minus arc-pass GT-start reference time. Geometry offset and sensor availability are reflected in supplied positions/t_decision_s; runtime, hysteresis and actuator delay are not measured. This is not full online latency.
definitions.undefined: Undefined metrics are JSON null, including absent-class AUROC/balanced accuracy/macro-F1.

metrics.timing_note: Event delays exclude preprocessing, model runtime and robot actuation.
